title: PHAME, 2446 SE Ladd Ave, Portland - Tech Lab (room 13), for Walsh Construction
format_note: NOT a takeoff.json. reference/takeoff-format.md runs are rectilinear E/S/W/N only and reserve angled walls as 'not in v1'; this room has three angled walls, so takeoff-check.py cannot validate it and build-takeoff.rb cannot build it. This file records the same facts (every value with its source) as a polygon, and clients/walsh-construction/build-techlab.rb builds it with WR_BuildRoom's own polygon/mitre/wall_run/door code and the shared dimension engine.
sources: plans/A1.1-code-study.pdf (Carleton Hart Architecture, sheet A1.1, 2448 x 1584 pt = 34 x 22 in, code study 09.22.2026)
plans/sarah-ramp-sketch.png (Sarah's red Ramp + PL mark, cropped from the same sheet)
anchor: plan-vector: stated drawing scale 1/8" = 1'-0" at native 34x22 (text 'SCALE: 1/8"' bottom left; sheet note says half scale only when printed at 11x17) => 9.000 pt per foot, 0.75 in per pt... i.e. 1 pt = 1.3333 in.
anchor_checks: dashed 'Prefab Recording Studio 8' X 14'' rectangle: 125.88 x 71.88 pt = 13'-11.8" x 7'-11.8" at 9 pt/ft (stated 14' x 8'); 0.12 pt = 0.16 in short, within the 0.24 pt dash stroke
red 15'-2 1/2" callout: extension lines 136.75 pt apart = 15'-2.3" at 9 pt/ft (stated 15'-2.5"); 0.2 in
room area: polygon below = 478.7 SF; plan states TECH LAB 479 SQ FT
units: inches, origin = Tech Lab interior SW corner, +x = plan right ('east'), +y = plan up ('north'). Plan-up is NOT true north; the sheet's north arrow was not used.
face_choice: New walls are black FILLED polygons with no stroke (3.6 pt = 4.8 in thick); the room face is the fill edge on the Tech Lab side. The existing exterior wall is two 0.84 pt stroked lines; the room face is the INNER line's centre. Tolerance from line weight: +/-0.6 in (half of a 0.84 pt stroke = 0.56 in), plus whatever the architect's own drafting carries (unknown).
walk: clockwise from the NW-most corner (the apex where the NW angled wall meets the exterior wall)

not_in_tech_lab: Door 1 (the brief's 'SE' door): its swing arc #9834-9842 is centred at (749.64, 702.72), 10.8 pt = 14.4 in EAST of the Tech Lab's east wall interior face (738.84) and 7.2 pt east of its exterior face (742.44). It opens into STORAGE 17, not the Tech Lab. Not built. The polygon area matching 479 SF confirms the east wall is the boundary.
ignored: Exterior wall inner face carries a 1.0-1.3 in projection, 23.6 in long, at about (217-236, 224-239) in room coords (line #9533). Not modelled; it sits on the exterior diagonal, well away from the booth.
Dashed 'Future kitchenette' outline west of the west wall is in Student Lounge 11, not here.
